Treatments and Medications That Can Cause Nutritional Deficiencies 
Avoiding certain foods is not the only concern that needs to be addressed regarding treatments. Many of the 
medications already described can also cause nutritional deficiencies. The client must know which foods they can 
increase in their diet to prevent deficiency (Table 18.5).
